correctness.rationale: The normalized two-step ordered nerve has only 0-,1-,2-cells. The complete triangle/square 2-cell presentation kills the fundamental group of every Hamming product; exact CW counts and Hurewicz–Whitehead give the sphere wedge. The free translation action is proved on nondegenerate simplex interiors, so covering-space fundamental group, Euler characteristic, and free C2-kernel give all integral quotient homology. Lefschetz traces and semisimplicity give the rational deck representation. Replayed finite-field boundary checks and seven exact integral orbit-chain Smith forms agree, but are not the basis for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: An unbounded natural two-parameter Cartesian-product family is completely classified at the first nontrivial ordered length, including a genuinely free deck action, finite first-homology torsion, all higher integral homology, and full rational translation character. The exact quotient result is structurally motivated by the newly emphasized homotopy-level enriched nerves and is not a one-instance table, a renaming, or merely a numerical Betti formula.
